warnings.text:
Refusal extends Schema.TaggedError; a schema error declaration, schema error Refusal { … }, writes the same failure with its Schema.
  No quick fix: a schema error's tag is its name.

PluginRefused extends Schema.TaggedError; a schema error declaration, schema error PluginRefused { … }, writes the same failure with its Schema.
  No quick fix: a schema error's tag is its name.

ModelRole holds a Schema.Struct; a schema declaration writes the struct and its type at once: schema ModelRole { … }.
  Its quick fix writes schema ModelRole { … }; vibelang --fix applies every such fix in the project.

PluginError extends Schema.TaggedError; a schema error declaration, schema error PluginError { … }, writes the same failure with its Schema.
  No quick fix: a schema error's tag is its name.

Plugins extends Context.Service; in VibeLang a service is a service declaration: service Plugins { … }.
  No quick fix: its members come from Service; write them in the declaration. Keep its key in the declaration: static readonly key = "flows/plugin/Plugins".

outputs.code:
/**
 * What a loaded plugin set contributes, folded into one value, and the typed
 * refusal a plugin that cannot load is recorded with.
 *
 * `Load.load` produces a {@link Contributions} value; hosts read it to draw
 * views and slots, list commands, and bind keys. Nothing in it runs plugin
 * code.
 *
 * @since 1.1.0
 */
import * as Schema from "effect/Schema";
/**
 * Why a plugin was not loaded. A closed set: a host lists it on the plugin
 * settings page and never guesses past it.
 *
 * @category models
 * @since 1.1.0
 */
export const Reason = Schema.Literals([
    "invalid",
    "incompatible",
    "range_unreadable",
    "schema_unresolved",
    "missing_dependency",
    "cycle",
    "undeclared_use",
    "capability_exceeded",
    "conflict",
    "unsupported_point",
    "stale_head",
    "reserved",
    "minimum_below_flow",
    "credential_input",
    "secret_field",
]);
/**
 * A plugin the loader refused, with the field that refused it.
 *
 * `plugin` is the manifest's id when it could be read, `path` the failing
 * field (`contributes.keybindings[2].event`), and `detail` a short sentence.
 * A refusal never carries a manifest value other than an id, so it is safe to
 * log and show.
 *
 * @category errors
 * @since 1.1.0
 */
export class Refusal extends Schema.TaggedError()("plugin/Refusal", {
    plugin: Schema.optional(Schema.String),
    reason: Reason,
    path: Schema.optional(Schema.String),
    detail: Schema.String,
}) {
}
/**
 * Where a plugin comes from: compiled into the build, a repository's
 * `.smithers/plugins/`, or a person's own.
 *
 * @category models
 * @since 1.1.0
 */
export const Tier = Schema.Literals(["built-in", "repository", "personal"]);
/**
 * A contribution point a host may advertise. View events are part of `views`.
 *
 * @category models
 * @since 1.1.0
 */
export const Point = Schema.Literals([
    "views",
    "slots",
    "commands",
    "keybindings",
    "flows",
    "cards",
    "settings",
    "triggers",
    "hooks",
    "taps",
    "modelRoles",
    "records",
]);
/**
 * No plugins, no contributions.
 *
 * @category constructors
 * @since 1.1.0
 */
export const empty = { plugins: [], views: [], slots: [], commands: [], keybindings: [] };

/**
 * The single typed failure of the plugin kernel.
 *
 * The public package contract is documented at
 * {@link https://smithers.sh/docs/reference/api/plugin}; D14 in
 * `docs/pages/design-decisions.md` bounds it to host-owned cell hooks.
 *
 * @since 1.0.0-rc.0
 */
import * as Schema from "effect/Schema";
/**
 * Closed set of plugin-system failure codes.
 *
 * @category models
 * @since 1.0.0-rc.0
 */
export const PluginErrorCode = Schema.Literals([
    "duplicate_name",
    "unknown_hook",
    "hook_kind_mismatch",
    "invalid_plugin",
    "apply_failed",
    "config_invalid",
    "cache_environment_invalid",
    "invalid_hook_result",
    "resource_limit",
    "hook_failed",
    "layer_failed",
]);
/**
 * Failure raised by plugin resolution, hook dispatch, config execution, or
 * layer construction.
 *
 * Parallel observer failures never fail the caller; they are returned from
 * `Plugins.parallel` with this same shape so they can be journalled on the
 * lossy telemetry channel.
 *
 * `cause` is the plugin's unredacted failure and may hold secrets; hosts
 * redact it before logging, persisting, or transmitting the error.
 *
 * @category errors
 * @since 1.0.0-rc.0
 */
export class PluginError extends Schema.TaggedError()("flows/plugin/PluginError", {
    code: PluginErrorCode,
    message: Schema.String,
    plugin: Schema.optional(Schema.String),
    hook: Schema.optional(Schema.String),
    path: Schema.optional(Schema.String),
    cause: Schema.optional(Schema.Unknown),
}) {
}

/**
 * The typed hook surface: hook kinds, the hook entry shape, and the shared
 * kernel's base hook catalog.
 *
 * The public package contract is documented at
 * {@link https://smithers.sh/docs/reference/api/plugin}. The shared catalog is limited to
 * `config` and `configResolved`;
 * `@smthrs/agent` adds only `cellRegistry`, `cellFlows`, and
 * `cellModelRequest`. Durable-core lifecycle policy is not a hook catalog.
 *
 * `FlowsHooks` is **open for augmentation, closed for dispatch**: a host
 * declares its hooks with `declare module "@smthrs/plugin"`, supplies the
 * matching runtime catalog, and dispatches only that bounded set.
 *
 * @since 1.0.0-rc.0
 */
/**
 * Runtime catalog of the shared kernel's hook names and kinds.
 *
 * The type system cannot enumerate an augmentable interface, so this constant
 * is what the `unknown_hook` guard checks against. A host passes its own
 * superset to {@link resolve}. The cell harness adds only the hooks it
 * dispatches; lifecycle and engine-policy hooks do not belong here.
 *
 * @category models
 * @since 1.0.0-rc.0
 */
const sharedHooks = Object.create(null);
Object.defineProperties(sharedHooks, {
    config: { value: "waterfall", enumerable: true },
    configResolved: { value: "parallel", enumerable: true },
});
/**
 * Frozen runtime catalog for the shared configuration hooks.
 *
 * @category models
 * @since 1.0.0-rc.0
 */
export const engineHooks = Object.freeze(sharedHooks);
/**
 * Normalizes a hook entry to its handler.
 *
 * @category utils
 * @since 1.0.0-rc.0
 */
export const handlerOf = (entry) => typeof entry === "function"
    ? entry
    : entry.handler;
/**
 * Reads the per-hook `order` of a hook entry.
 *
 * @category utils
 * @since 1.0.0-rc.0
 */
export const orderOf = (entry) => typeof entry === "function" ? undefined : entry.order;

/**
 * The plugin object: a plain record produced by a factory function.
 *
 * The public package contract is documented at
 * {@link https://smithers.sh/docs/reference/api/plugin}. The shipped consumer is the
 * assembled cell host in `@smthrs/agent`;
 * durable-core policy continues to use Effect services and constructor
 * options rather than plugin lifecycle hooks.
 *
 * @since 1.0.0-rc.0
 */
/**
 * Identity constructor that pins a plugin literal to `FlowsPlugin` so excess
 * hook keys are rejected at the definition site.
 *
 * @category constructors
 * @since 1.0.0-rc.0
 */
export const make = (plugin) => plugin;
